webhooks.detail: REST webhook subscriptions (POST /webhooks) on tasks, projects, etc. X-Hook-Secret handshake, X-Hook-Signature HMAC; events API polling also available

evidence.quote: Webhook subscriptions can only be created by users who have access to the specific object (e.g., task).

sandbox.detail: Developer sandbox = temporary Asana domain with limited users; requested via form, provisioning up to a week, valid max one year. No self-serve free dev account found.

evidence.quote: A developer sandbox is a temporary Asana domain with limited users.

rate_limits.summary: 150 req/min free domain, 1,500 req/min paid, per token; search 60/min; 50 concurrent GET, 15 concurrent writes; 429 + Retry-After

evidence.quote: Limits are based on minute-long windows and differ depending on whether the domain is free or paid
